links.outcome: Loss of pathological variability and diagnostic reliability when models train on AI-generated data
links.effect: Rare findings such as pneumothorax and effusions vanish from synthetic content; demographics skew toward middle-aged male phenotypes; false reassurance rates tripled to 40%.
links.quote: Specifically, rare but critical findings, including pneumothorax and effusions, vanish from the synthetic content generated by AI models, while demographic representations skew heavily toward middle-aged male phenotypes.

links.outcome: Clinical usefulness of AI-generated documentation across generations without human verification
links.effect: Blinded physician evaluation found AI-generated documentation clinically useless after just two generations; false reassurance rates tripled to 40%.
links.quote: Blinded physician evaluation confirms that this decoupling of confidence and accuracy renders AI-generated documentation clinically useless after just two generations.

links.outcome: Decoupling of model confidence from diagnostic accuracy across generations
links.effect: Models continue issuing reassuring reports while failing to detect life-threatening pathology; false reassurance rates tripled to 40%.
links.quote: Models continue to issue reassuring reports while failing to detect life-threatening pathology, with false reassurance rates tripling to 40%.

links.outcome: Effect of mitigation strategies on preserving diversity under model collapse
links.effect: Synthetic volume scaling failed to prevent collapse; mixing real data with quality-aware filtering effectively preserved diversity.
links.quote: We systematically evaluate three mitigation strategies that can be easily integrated into existing clinical workflows, finding that while synthetic volume scaling fails to prevent collapse, mixing real data with quality-aware filtering effectively preserves diversity.
